title: Durable Bubble Machine for Party: 3 Power Modes for Non-Stop Fun - 18000+ Bubbles Per Minute High Output 30 Mins Bubbles per Refill - Kids Safe Auto-Stop for Outdoor Backyard Birthday
features: Non-stop Party Fun: Zerhunt bubble maker offers 3 power options: ① Plug in bubble machine with adapter (unlimited play), ② use 4 C batteries (batteries not included), or ③ connect USB cable to a power bank (charge on the go). Powerful motor shoots 18,000+ bubbles/min – 3X more than ordinary machines – covering half your backyard in 30 seconds. Best of all: bubbles keep flowing through the entire birthday party. Kids chase and laugh nonstop – no crying from dead batteries, no hunting for spares.

Toddler-Safe Design: Made of durable, high‑quality ABS plastic with strong toughness and excellent rust resistance. ASTM certified for toy safety – friendly for children, toddlers, pets, and adults. A special feature for little ones: built‑in stall protection. If any object touches the rotating wand, it automatically stops spinning within 0.1 seconds. The moment accidental contact occurs, it safely pauses. Perfect for curious toddlers – a bubble machine designed specifically for their safety.

320ml Large Capacity: The tank holds 320ml – one fill gives you 30 minutes of continuous bubbles. For a 1‑hour outdoor celebration, you only need to refill once halfway. The rest of the time, you can relax, enjoy BBQ, and chase bubbles with the kids – ensuring hours of non‑stop fun. Easily calculate how much bubble solution you'll need for every memorable occasion.

Whisper-Quiet & Ultimate Portability: Experience bubble magic in serenity with our advanced motor (under 55dB). Perfect for baby showers, indoor sensory play, or outdoor fun, it enhances the moment without overpowering music or conversations. Crafted with an ergonomic handle and feather-light body, it’s the ultimate grab-and-go companion. From cozy living rooms to camping trips or backyard celebrations, effortlessly bring endless joy wherever you go!

Durable & Ideal Gift: A bubble machine that grows with your toddler and delights pets. Inside: metal gears + brushless motor – tested for 500 hours continuous use. At 2 hours/week, this lasts 5 years – from first steps to preschool. A thoughtful gift for a toddler or a bubble‑chasing dog. Perfect for backyard time, park runs with pets, weddings, stage shows, parties, and camping – it effortlessly creates a dreamy bubble atmosphere for any occasion.

Important Notes： Use only the pre-mixed bubble solution for optimal bubble output. Diluted soapy water or laundry detergent will not work as well. Keep the bubble machine dry. Wipe it thoroughly right after use. Do not wash the inside with water to avoid damaging internal parts. Store indoors in a dry area when not in use for an extended period. Proper care will prolong the product’s lifespan.
